name: pokewalker-browser-port
description: Native C firmware port with local browser inspection and physical input

scripts.build: python3 build.py && python3 prepare-site.py && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:ui: python3 prepare-site.py && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: node verify.mjs && node verify-pacing.mjs && node verify-physics.mjs && node verify-audio.mjs
scripts.dev: python3 prepare-site.py && npm run dev --prefix client
